title: Read-only MCP connection to the live index and its surface card
goal: The index's answers show in NERV as a bricks surface card, read-only, with Italian labels in chat
acceptance: Failing test first, across the API and the component, on an invented fake index server: a "waiting on me" answer renders the bricks surface card with each row's source link, the snapshot time and a link to the index screen; a tool that writes is refused at registration; an unreachable index is reported, not shown as no work

The index registers through the remote MCP path of F-123-T01 with every tool Green; the tool names and shapes follow the contract row coordinator:F-024-T04 writes in the coordinator's docs/SOLUTION.md; NERV stores none of the index's data
Chat labels in Italian (for example "In attesa di te", "Bloccato da", "Indice live"); an Italian Gauntlet case for the chat request, or a recorded skip with its reason
privacy: Neutral invented records, repositories and results only; no tokens in configuration examples, tests or logs.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 from the coordinator proposal's 1 h (live index decision page, row S6), at agent speed, failing test first; the remote MCP path (F-123-T01) and bricks surface cards (F-130-T19) already exist. Not a measurement.
